summary: AgomAb Therapeutics NV, a Belgian clinical-stage biopharma, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 1, 2026, reporting positive topline data from the 48-week open-label extension of the Phase 2a STENOVA trial of ontunisertib in fibrostenosing Crohn's disease. The company cited a favorable safety profile through up to 60 weeks, a 3% annualized disease-related event rate with one endoscopic balloon dilation and no surgeries, radiological trends toward stricture stabilization, and sustained disease control. No transaction terms apply; the release supports initiating the global NOV-ERA Phase 2b study in coming months. No deal, price, premium, or structural mechanics are present, so this is a routine clinical-data disclosure rather than a special situation. Watch for NOV-ERA initiation timing and any regulatory interactions as the operative catalysts.
